items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Who was with Ori? ... Kid Ori on the trombone ... Henry Martin, yeah. All them days now, yeah.

ctx.x: Ask him who was with Ed Ori.
And Eddie, he's up there yet too, isn't he? With Kid Ori, yeah.
So, ask him? Ask him who was with Ori.
